intent: A drowned fen-bride's gothic gown: a pale mist bodice, a narrow black-water sash with one wisp-blue clasp, and one continuous sage front panel widening into a broad hem tier, with the twig crown and dark back panel of hanging strands kept, reading from the high camera as a pale, narrow-waisted, broad-skirted figure with slim sleeves falling behind the arms.
requests: A translucent gauze for the bridal veil; armour parts have no alpha, so the veil is solid mist cloth.
